title: Fix quadrature loop to ti.static for Python list access (C2)

implementation_steps: Change line 425 from 'for q in range(N_QP):' to 'for q in ti.static(range(N_QP)):'
Update comment at line 424 to explain element-type constant rationale
Verify GRAD_AT_QUAD[q][a][d] and QUAD_WEIGHTS[q] access patterns work
acceptance_criteria: Comment documents rationale for convention exception
verification_commands: uv run pytest packages/mechdsl-core/tests/test_taichi_printer.py -v --tb=short -k 'quad_loop or runtime_quad or static_mesh'
risks: Contradicts 'never unroll mesh indices' convention — R3.1.10 updates convention docs. Risk: ~240 unrolled lines within 2000-line kernel budget
